notes.title: Important news:
notes.notes:
I am excited to announce that in the coming days, all of my products will become completely free.

This is because I want everyone to be able to play and enjoy my creations.

I truly thank from the bottom of my heart all the people who have bought my video games over the years, supporting me and their development.

Thank you so much to everyone, and I hope this announcement will be well received.
